<thought>First, retrieve polymorph data for a representative set of oxide compositions (up to 40) using the batch tool with the given energy and count limits, storing the files in a sub‑directory of the work area.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "TiO2","Fe2O3","Al2O3","SiO2","MgO","CaO","ZnO","CuO","NiO","CoO",
        "MnO","Cr2O3","SnO2","PbO","BaO","SrO","Na2O","K2O","Li2O","ZrO2",
        "HfO2","V2O5","MoO3","WO3","GeO2","Ga2O3","In2O3","CdO","HgO",
        "Bi2O3","Sb2O3","Ti2O3","FeO","Fe3O4","Cu2O","Ni2O3","Co3O4","Mn2O3","CrO3"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/workdir/5/ml_oxides_trial_11/polymorphs"
}
</action_input>
